consentIntro: {client} wants to use your Tugra account over MCP.
returnsTo: After you decide, you go back to {host}.
teamHint: The connection can only see and change this team.
noTeams: You are not a member of any team, so there is nothing to connect.
scopesHint: Read is always included. What you can grant depends on your role in the team.
invalidRequest: This connection request is not valid.
invalidRequestHint: Start the connection again from your MCP client.
failed: Could not complete the request. Try again.
connectedDesc: Apps you signed in to over OAuth. Access tokens last one hour and renew on their own; revoke a client to cut it off at once.
revokeBody: {client} loses access to {team} immediately and has to be connected again.
empty: Add the hub's MCP URL to a client that supports OAuth and it appears here after you approve it.
